llm.guidance: Install only if you are comfortable sending the locations you check, plus your Camino API key for authentication, to Camino's API. Prefer the specific skill install command rather than installing the whole Camino suite unless you want the other skills too, and avoid querying highly sensitive exact locations if that privacy tradeoff is not acceptable.
